settings.label: Server
settings.help: The root address of your YunLu Music server, such as http://192.168.1.10:9527. /music is optional.

settings.label: Source
settings.help: Optional wy or tx override. Leave empty to use the source selected in the YunLu Music web player.

settings.label: Username
settings.help: Your YunLu Music player account. Needed for playlists, likes and play history.

settings.label: Password
settings.help: Stored on this computer by MyGo Music.

settings.label: Player password
settings.help: Only if the server asks for a password before playing music.
